name: Maioka Momiji
source:
Momiji is a student at Saint Michael's Nursing School and [url=https://vndb.org/c42430]Kaede[/url]'s only blood-related child. She wants to be a great nurse just like her mother, but her greatest dream revolves around her older brother, [url=https://vndb.org/c63887]Shinobu[/url]. She's always had strong feelings for her foster brother, but he has a hard time thinking about her as anything more than a little sister, especially since she can act like a spoiled little girl. Their relationship might become a romantic one depending on whether Momiji manages to win over his heart.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582494-kango-shicyauzo/faqs/36050]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
